title: Homogeneous action has the expected degree support
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes, $L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module and $J=\ker j$ with $J^2=0$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-sc-invertible-module, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Let $n\ge0$, let $T$ be a TensorGradedPresentation with ideal module $I$, injections $k_d:K_d\to I$, where $K_d=\ker(\eta_{L^d})$, and section inclusions $c_d$ [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $D$ equal canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons for $j,L,J^2=0,n$ [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Let $f:\mathcal O_Z\to (j^*L)^n$ and $s=\operatorname{tensorGradedSection}(T,D,0,\operatorname{tensorPowSection}(f,1))$ [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-product-projection]. Suppose $\sigma_U:C(U)\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal O_X(U)}(I(U))$ are ring maps satisfying $i(\sigma_U(p(b))y)=b i(y)$ and commuting with all restrictions. Let $\mu:C(X)\to\operatorname{End}(I)$ be a ring map with $(\mu(g))_U(y)=\sigma_U(g|_U)y$ [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-ringed-space-algebra-module]. For each $d\ge0$ there is a module-sheaf map $v:K_d\to K_{n+d}$ such that $k_d\gg\mu(s)=v\gg k_{n+d}$. Here $\gg$ is categorical composition in left-to-right order. No particular tensor formula for $v$ is asserted.

proof.text: Use closedImmersion_unit_epi and the unique adjunction comparison to obtain epimorphy of tensorGradedUnit. Mathlib local surjectivity for abelian sheaves gives a lift of a homogeneous quotient section near each point of any open.

Apply tensorKernel_section_product to the lifted section and the restricted degree-d kernel section. The b_quotient, k_inclusion and b_multiply fields, together with hlocal and hglobal, identify the restricted action with k_(a+d) of the resulting kernel section. Cancel i using shortExact.mono_f.

Set r=k_d followed by the global action, pi=(degree(a+d)).tau_1, and v=r followed by pi. Locally k_(a+d) followed by pi is the identity, so r=v followed by k_(a+d). Naturality and sheaf separation prove equality globally. Substitute the section defining tensorGradedSection and transport a=n*(0+1) to n.

theorem tensorGradedCoefficient_action_support {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (n : ℕ) (T : TensorGradedPresentation j L) (D : TensorBoundaryComparisonData j L n)
    (hD : canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons j L hI n = D)
    (d : ℕ) (f : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ ((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n)
    (σ : ∀ U : X.Opens, T.C.right.obj.obj (op U) →+*
      Module.End ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op U)) (T.I.val.obj (op U)))
    (μ : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤) →+* End T.I)
    (hlocal : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (b : T.B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      @id (T.B.right.obj.obj (op U))
        (T.i.val.app (op U) (σ U (T.p.right.hom.app (op U) b) y)) =
        b * @id (T.B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (T.i.val.app (op U) y))
    (hrestrict : ∀ (U V : X.Opens) (a : V ⟶ U)
      (g : T.C.right.obj.obj (op U)) (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      T.I.val.map a.op (σ U g y) = σ V (T.C.right.obj.map a.op g) (T.I.val.map a.op y))
    (hglobal : ∀ (g : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤)) (U : X.Opens)
      (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      (μ g).val.app (op U) y = σ U (T.C.right.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op g) y) :
    ∃ v : kernel (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow d)) ⟶
        kernel (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow (n + d))),
      T.k d ≫ μ (tensorGradedSection T D 0 (tensorPowSection f 1)) =
        v ≫ T.k (n + d)
